statements.statement: The service provided was mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229)
The claim was denied under reason code CO-197
The denial was based on authorization missing
The clinical indication documents recurrent palpitations and lightheadedness
There is concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attacks
The patient has a personal history of cerebral infarction
Mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered for extended ambulatory assessment
The purpose was to correlate symptomatic events with potential arrhythmic activity
The purpose was to guide anticoagulation and rate control strategies
